content:
Let \(N=2^{100}-1\), the number of non-empty subsets.

Map each subset \(M\) to \(M'=\{101-x:x\in M\}\). Then
\[
\max(M')=101-\min(M).
\]
Summing over all non-empty subsets \(M\),
\[
\sum_M \max(M)=\sum_M \max(M')=\sum_M (101-\min(M))=101N-\sum_M \min(M).
\]
Thus
\[
\sum_M \max(M)+\sum_M \min(M)=101N.
\]
Therefore the average characteristic is
\[
\frac{101N}{N}=101.
\]

\[
\boxed{101}
\]
